title: canAccess: role check

spec.text: canAccess(userId, resource, action) returns whether the user may perform the action. Viewers can read, editors can also edit, owners can also delete. Grants are stored per resource in the grants table.

context: Resources form a tree: folders contain folders and documents. grants.roleFor returns the user's role on exactly that resource, or null. The sharing product doc is still being written.
